dog.description_text:
My foster writes: I am a super loving dog, need to be by my people all times of the day but I am very trusting and do great around strangers, just not alone! I am very relaxed and like to sleep and lay around all day but don't be fooled because I still am social and will make sure you know how much I love you even if im sleeping all day! (I will sleep ontop of you!) I am great at potty trained, going to bed, staying asleep, and dealing with chaos. I am friendly to strangers and won't go crazy if I see another dog or animal or loud noise! I am trained to sit and know basic body language movements. I love car rides, putting my head out of the window but most importantly I love humans. My dream day would be where I can go on a walk with my owner, sit in the grass for a while with them, and then go home and cuddle up with them to watch a movie and maybe get 1 bite of leftovers (sushi is my favorite!) If you are not petting me I will make sure to show you I want to be petted by nudging you until you pet me! I will also do the same until you let me on the bed with you! I am super easy going you do not have to worry about me in busy places, overwhelming and loud places, quiet and dark places, etc. I can manage it all! (just as long as you are by my side!)

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I am a sweet, social, older gentleman, looking for the perfect forever home!

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.

I would appreciate slow introductions to new people and places to help me feel safe.

I'm ready to learn! I need a patient person who has the time to work on training with me.
dog.name: Loki
